folkways.refusal.cart.not_at_station: The cart is not at this station
folkways.refusal.cart.nowhere_to_place: There is no room to set the cart down
folkways_carts.ponder.carts.text_1: Draw a cart line with the colony book: every point is a station. Choose a hand cart or a supply cart, and whether it runs out and back or round a loop. The colony makes the cart and sets it down at the first station.
folkways_carts.ponder.carts.text_2: A hauler draws the cart from station to station and it stands a while at each, for goods to go aboard and come off. A supply cart line takes a tamed grown horse from a horse pasture; it is led, and no longer counted or culled there. Lines need wide gateways and room at corners.
